线圈电流一变，它的变化磁场就在它身上激出电动势，阻碍这个变化: When the coil's current changes, its changing magnetic field induces an EMF in the coil itself that opposes the change

线圈变成电源：灯泡电流反向、跳到原来的 2.0 倍: The coil becomes a source: the bulb current reverses and jumps to 2.0 times its previous value

两个灯泡规格相同，为什么闭合开关时 A₁ 比 A₂ 慢亮？教材为什么先调 R、再: The two bulbs are identical. Why does A₁ light more slowly than A₂ when the switch closes? Why does the textbook adjust R first, then R₁?
先把 R 调到两灯一样亮（6.0 Ω），再把 R₁ 调到两灯正常发光（3.0 Ω: First set R so both bulbs are equally bright (6.0 Ω), then set R₁ so both light normally (3.0 Ω), then close the switch and wait for it to settle
本步慢放 1/10，看清「A₁ 慢慢亮」；下面都是真实时间。进入时开关断开、R: This step runs at 1/10 speed so you can see "A₁ brightens slowly"; everything below is real time. You enter with the switch open, R = 10.0 Ω (unbalanced), R₁ = 0.0 Ω: after closing, the bulbs are clearly different. Balance to R = 6.0 Ω (= coil B's R_L) → branch currents differ by 0.000 A and the bulbs are equally bright; with R₁ = 3.0 Ω both reach 0.2500 A (rated 0.25 A). At the instant of closing: A₂ jumps to 0.2857 A (1.1429 times A₁'s steady value, then settles to 0.2500 A, about 30 % brighter than steady at first), A₁'s brightness ratio is still 0.00, E_L = −5.1429 V; at t = 1τ = 0.0972 s: ratio 0.40, E_L = −1.8920 V; 3τ = 0.2917 s: 0.90 / −0.2560 V; 5τ = 0.4861 s: 0.99 / −0.0347 V.
The self-induced EMF opposes (doesn't prevent) the current increase: the coil current grows slowly from 0 to the steady I∞ = 0.2500 A (τ = 0.0972 s, extension); branch A₂ has no coil, so it jumps straight up and overshoots. In steady state di/dt = 0 and E_L = 0, so the coil is just its DC resistance of 6.0 Ω; hence "both bulbs equally bright" means R = R_L, and "both bulbs lit normally" means R₁ = 3.0 Ω.
教材的调节顺序是考点：先调 R 使两灯一样亮（两支路电阻相等），再调 R₁ 使两: The textbook's adjustment order is tested: first set R so both bulbs are equally bright (equal branch resistances), then set R₁ so both light normally; in the other order the brightness can't be explained.
闭合瞬间 A₂ 先超亮再回落（0.2857 → 0.2500 A），A₁ 从 0: At the instant of closing A₂ overshoots and settles (0.2857 → 0.2500 A) while A₁ rises slowly from 0; that's what the two opposite field lines in Fig. 2.4-2 mean.
「慢」不是「到不了」：稳态 0.2500 A 与没有线圈时一样，稳态 E_L =: "Slow" doesn't mean "never gets there": the steady 0.2500 A is the same as without a coil, steady E_L = 0, and the coil is just a wire with 6.0 Ω of resistance.
去掉这一步：学生会把「阻碍」背成「阻止」，以为闭合后 A₁ 永远亮不起来。: Skip this step and students memorize "opposes" as "prevents", thinking A₁ will never light after closing.
必考：闭合瞬间为什么 A₁ 慢亮、A₂ 先超亮（A7.8）；「阻碍」不是「阻止」: Exam must-know: why A₁ lights slowly and A₂ overshoots at the instant of closing (A7.8); "opposes" isn't "prevents" (A7.1); the adjustment order (A7.7).

At the instant of opening: the brightness ratio jumps to 4.00 (4 times as bright as before; exactly the 4.0 warning threshold, and the test uses "greater than", so the default setup doesn't warn), E_L = +9.0000 V (3.00 times the 3.0 V supply), and i_bulb jumps to −0.5000 A (reversed); at t = 1τ = 0.1111 s: ratio 0.54, E_L 3.3109 V, i_bulb −0.1839 A; 2τ: 0.07 / 1.2180 V; 3τ: 0.01 / 0.4481 V. 断开后线圈本身就是一个电源，电流沿「线圈 → 灯泡」这个唯一还通的回路继续流：灯: After opening, the coil itself is a source, and current keeps flowing around the only loop still closed, "coil → bulb": the bulb current jumps from +0.2500 A to −0.5000 A (equal in size to the previous coil current, opposite in direction). The coil's own 6.0 Ω is less than the bulb's 12.0 Ω, so I_L0 > I_bulb0 and the bulb gets brighter than before (textbook p.43: "sometimes even brighter than before the switch was opened"); all the energy for this comes from the magnetic energy stored in the coil.

把电流传感器串进灯泡支路，合上开关等读数稳定，再断开看曲线: Put the current sensor in series with the bulb branch, close the switch and wait for the reading to settle, then open it and look at the curve
本步慢放 1/10，让曲线一节一节长出来。屏幕上两条曲线：i_L 实线、i_灯: This step runs at 1/10 speed so the curve grows section by section. The screen shows two curves: i_L solid and i_bulb dashed, with the x-axis 0 → 5.5τ (real time) and the y-axis including the negative half. Before opening, i_bulb = +0.2500 A and i_L = +0.5000 A; at opening, i_bulb jumps to −0.5000 A (below the axis) and i_L decays exponentially from +0.5000 A; the two curves mirror each other, i_bulb + i_L = 0.000 A. Read from the curve: peak 0.5000 A ÷ pre-opening 0.2500 A → ρ = 2.0000, peak brightness ratio 4.0000. Sampling 1000 Hz, resolution 0.01 A, range ±2.00 A: the 0.0770 s flash isn't one dot on the graph but a stretch of about 77 samples.
指针式电表读不出 0.1 s 级的过程，传感器加计算机能（教材 p.42）；方向: A needle meter can't read a 0.1 s process, but a sensor with a computer can (textbook p.42); the reversal isn't "dimming" but a genuinely reversed current, which is exactly what item 2 of the textbook's try-it on p.42 shows by "measuring the current through resistor R".
采样 1000 Hz · 分辨率 0.01 A · 量程 ±2.00 A: Sampling 1000 Hz · resolution 0.01 A · range ±2.00 A

铭牌写 2.0 H，为什么测出来不是 2.0 H？这是「测错了」还是「元件本来就: The label says 2.0 H. Why doesn't it measure 2.0 H? Is it "measured wrong" or "the component just isn't its nominal value"?
把「理想器材」换成「真实器材」，回到图2.4-1 读通电段: Switch "Ideal equipment" to "Real equipment" and go back to Fig. 2.4-1 to read the switch-on segment
打开后元件取真值：L′ = 2.2629 H（铭牌 2.0 H，+13.14 %: Turned on, components take their true values: L′ = 2.2629 H (rated 2.0 H, +13.14 %, within ±15 % tolerance), R_L′ = 5.8851 Ω, R_bulb′ = 11.9869 Ω. Switch-on (U 6.0 V, R₁ 3.0 Ω, R 6.0 Ω): τ′ = 0.1107 s (nominal 0.0972 s), i_L at 1τ = 0.1590 A (shown as 0.16 A after 0.01 A quantization), A₁ steady 0.2515 A, A₂ steady 0.2499 A (0.0016 A apart: invisible to the eye, only visible in the readings). Then switch to Fig. 2.4-3 and open: I_L0′ = 0.5098 A, ρ′ = 2.0368, peak brightness ratio 4.1487 (already past 4.0), E_L(0⁺)′ = 9.1105 V.
两件不同的事：① 标称不等于实际（元件容差 +13.14 %，不是测错）→ 所以: Two different things: ① nominal isn't actual (component tolerance +13.14 %, not a measuring mistake) → so inductance must be measured (that's exactly why textbook p.42 measures I-t curves with a sensor); ② measurement error itself comes in two kinds: 0.01 A resolution means "jumping ±0.01 A", which only tells you "how accurate", not "too high or too low"; sampling has a direction: at 1000 Hz the first sample is at 0.001 s, so the peak reading is always too low (B 0.9 %, A 6.8 %, C 8.1 %; the smaller τ, the larger the bias). The same seed always giving the same readings is a software property, not a basis for classifying errors.
facts B2 第 9 行、B2.1 第 10、16 条、B3 第 3 条、B: facts B2 row 9, B2.1 items 10, 16, B3 item 3, B1.1; tables 8, 9; A2.7, A7.4; textbook p.42, p.43 margin note

两类偏差分开说：分辨率是 ± 跳动（只能判准不准）；采样峰值有方向、一定偏小（B: Keep the two kinds of deviation apart: resolution is ± jitter (only tells accuracy); the sampled peak has a direction and is always low (B 0.9 %, A 6.8 %, C 8.1 %).

铁芯里没有导线，为什么会有电流、还发热？把整块铁芯切成一叠薄片，为什么就省电了？: There's no wire in an iron core. Why is there current, and why does it heat up? Why does cutting the solid core into a stack of thin sheets save energy?
点 3D 里的铁芯换叠片：1 片（整块）→ 5 片 → 10 片: Tap the iron core in 3D to change laminations: 1 sheet (solid) → 5 sheets → 10 sheets
铁芯截面里画出虚线涡流环，层数等于叠片数、每层一个环（整块 1 片 = 一个大环: Dashed eddy-current loops are drawn in the core's cross-section, one loop per sheet (solid, 1 sheet = one big loop, as in Fig. 2.3-2); relative loss reading: 1 sheet → 1.00, 5 sheets → 0.04, 10 sheets → 0.01 (1/n², extension); as the flux grows, the eddy current's field opposes the original field (B̂_eddy·B̂ = −1).
变化的磁场在导体内部直接激起环形电流（不需要导线）；金属有电阻就发热（P = I: A changing magnetic field drives loop currents directly inside a conductor (no wire needed); metal has resistance, so it heats up (P = I²R); smelting furnaces and induction cookers want exactly this heat. There are two ways to reduce it: raise the resistivity (silicon steel), and stack mutually insulated silicon steel sheets (cutting the eddy loops so each sheet's loop is smaller).
涡流不需要导线：任何导体块，穿过它的磁通量一变就有涡流。: Eddy currents need no wire: in any block of conductor, a change in magnetic flux through it causes eddy currents.
减小涡流靠的是薄片加绝缘层把回路切断，不是「硅钢不导电」。: Reducing eddy currents works by cutting the loops with thin sheets and insulation, not because "silicon steel doesn't conduct".
1/n² 是工程通用式的量化，教材本节没给 → 一律标拓展。: 1/n² is a general engineering formula the textbook doesn't give in this section → always labeled extension.
去掉这一步：学生只知道「涡流有害」，不知道「切薄为什么就有效」。: Skip this step and students only know "eddy currents are harmful", not "why thinner sheets work".
必考：电磁炉为什么盘面不热而锅热；硅钢片为什么能减小涡流。: Exam must-know: why an induction cooktop stays cool while the pan gets hot; why silicon steel sheets reduce eddy currents.
铝管不吸磁，磁体为什么落得那么慢？把管子锯一道裂缝，会变快还是变慢？: Aluminum isn't magnetic. Why does the magnet fall so slowly? If you saw a slit along the tube, does it fall faster or slower?
把管子从整根换成有裂缝的，再换成没有管，各看一次落 1 m 的用时: Switch the tube from solid to slit, then to no tube, and watch the time to fall 1 m each time
落 1 m 的用时读数：整根铝管 3.3639 s（收尾速度 0.3000 m/: Time to fall 1 m: solid aluminum tube 3.3639 s (terminal speed 0.3000 m/s, τ_v = 0.0306 s); slit aluminum tube 0.9557 s (terminal speed 1.2000 m/s); no tube (free fall) 0.4518 s (= √(2h/g), calculable by hand). As soon as the magnet starts falling it slows to nearly constant speed; the magnetic force always opposes the motion (F̂·v̂ = −1.000).
磁体在导体里运动 → 磁通量变化 → 涡流 → 安培力，而安培力总是阻碍运动（教: A magnet moving in a conductor → changing flux → eddy currents → magnetic force, and that force always opposes the motion (textbook p.37). The slit cuts the eddy current loops, so damping almost disappears and it falls fast (textbook p.39 exercise 3, Fig. 2.3-15 a/b). The textbook only gives two qualitative amounts, "no more than 0.5 s for 1 m" and "a long while"; this lesson's 3.3639 / 0.9557 s are lesson settings (extension).
facts A2.12、A2.21、A3.4、A4.9、A7.11；p.37 原: facts A2.12, A2.21, A3.4, A4.9, A7.11; p.37 wording, p.38 try-it, p.39 exercise 3; B2.1 items 12, 13; table 7
阻尼不是「让物体停住」，是永远与运动方向反向；没有相对运动就没有阻尼。: Damping doesn't "stop the object"; it always opposes the motion, and with no relative motion there's no damping.
自由下落 0.4518 s 与教材「不超过 0.5 s」相容，铝管 3.3639: Free fall in 0.4518 s fits the textbook's "no more than 0.5 s", and 3.3639 s in the aluminum tube fits "a long while" (the numbers are settings).
铝管不吸磁，起作用的是感应电流，不是磁力吸引。: Aluminum isn't magnetic; it's the induced current that acts, not magnetic attraction.
去掉这一步：「涡流有害要减小」之外，学生得不到「涡流有用」的一面。: Skip this step and, beyond "eddy currents are harmful and must be reduced", students never see the useful side of eddy currents.

三只线圈任你挑一只装上，要做到「断开时灯泡闪一下、但灯泡不至于烧掉」——你挑哪只: Pick one of the three coils to fit so that "the bulb flashes on opening, but doesn't burn out". Which one, and why doesn't turning up the voltage help?
换一只线圈，合上开关充满再断开，让三条判据同时成立并保持 10 s: Swap in a coil, close the switch to charge it and then open it, so all three conditions hold at once for 10 s
判据三条（必须同时在断电段）：① 接法是图2.4-3 且开关已断开；② ρ >: Three conditions (all in the switch-off segment): ① the circuit is Fig. 2.4-3 and the switch is open; ② ρ > 1 (it really flashes); ③ peak brightness ratio ≤ 4.0 (not too hard). Coil B: ρ = 2.0000, peak brightness ratio 4.0000 → all three hold (U at 3.0 V or 6.0 V both work, ρ is unchanged); coil A: ρ = 6.0000, peak 36.0000 → flashes too hard, warning, fails; coil C: ρ = 0.4000, peak 0.1600 → no flash, fails; coil B in real mode: ρ′ = 2.0368, peak 4.1487 → just past 4.0, so the warning sounds. One valid solution: Fig. 2.4-3, U 3.0 V, coil B.

闭合开关的瞬间，与线圈串联的灯泡 A₁ 比 A₂ 亮得慢，原因是: At the instant the switch closes, bulb A₁ in series with the coil lights more slowly than A₂ because
线圈里有电阻，把电流限小了: The coil's resistance limits the current
线圈的自感电动势阻碍电流增加: The coil's self-induced EMF opposes the current increase
线圈把电流存起来，用完了才放: The coil stores current and only releases it when full
A₁ 的灯丝比 A₂ 粗: A₁'s filament is thicker than A₂'s
电流从无到有时 di/dt 最大，自感电动势与电流方向相反、阻碍增加；稳态时 E: When current goes from zero to flowing, di/dt is largest, and the self-induced EMF opposes the current and its increase; in steady state E_L = 0 and both bulbs are equally bright (A2.3, A2.4).
开关断开后，灯泡还能亮一小段时间，这段时间里灯泡的电流: After the switch opens the bulb stays lit briefly. During this time the bulb's current
方向不变、慢慢变小: Keeps its direction and slowly decreases
方向与原来相反、大小跳到线圈原来的电流: Reverses direction and jumps to the coil's previous current
方向不变、大小跳到线圈原来的电流: Keeps its direction and jumps to the coil's previous current
断开后线圈当电源，电流沿「线圈 → 灯泡」继续流：i_灯(0⁺) = −I_L0: After opening, the coil acts as a source and current keeps flowing along "coil → bulb": i_bulb(0⁺) = −I_L0, reversed and equal in size to the previous coil current (A2.17, A2.19).
断电后灯泡「闪一下」（比原来更亮）的条件是: The condition for the bulb to "flash" (get brighter than before) after switch-off is
电压 U 足够大: The voltage U is large enough
自感系数 L 足够大: The self-inductance L is large enough
线圈自身电阻小于灯泡电阻: The coil's own resistance is less than the bulb's
线圈自身电阻大于灯泡电阻: The coil's own resistance is greater than the bulb's
ρ = I_L0/I_灯0 = R_灯/R_L，ρ > 1 才闪；与 U 无关，: ρ = I_L0/I_bulb0 = R_bulb/R_L, and it only flashes if ρ > 1; it doesn't depend on U, and L only decides how long it glows (A2.14, A7.4).
